title: Cost planning and cleanup
summary: Azure budgets can notify you about spending. Review actual resource costs and plan cleanup; notifications are not a general guarantee that spending stops.
introduction: Azure budgets can notify you about spending. Review actual resource costs and plan cleanup; notifications are not a general guarantee that spending stops. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Azure budgets can notify you about spending. Review actual resource costs and plan cleanup; notifications are not a general guarantee that spending stops.

blocks.code:
Fictional budget: 10 units
Alert at 80 percent: 8 units
Cleanup list: only resources created for this approved practice

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Never delete a shared resource group as casual cleanup.
